correctness.rationale: The gap criterion reduces covering every factor to inspection of unmarked contiguous gaps. Explicit four-position and three-position sets cover all parameter regimes. In the complementary regime the four uniquely occurring factors 011, 110, 001 and \(0^e\) have pairwise disjoint occurrence intervals, giving a matching lower bound. The enumeration follows by b=4+k, c=3+i, e=c+1+j, n=13+k+2i+j. Direct independent raw-factor checks validated exact minima for 216 parameter triples, constructed witnesses for 1,728 triples plus 160 samples, and length counts through n=100. Infinite quantifiers rest on the proof, not the tests.

value.rationale: Minimal string attractors are a standard compression-related invariant; the first four-position obstruction in a natural sparse five-run family is resolved by explicit unique-factor geometry, with a sharp three-parameter classification and rational length distribution. A nondegenerate limiting proportion 1/2 makes it a structural and enumerative result, not a finite isolated numerical example. The family is motivated by two isolated symbol runs and competition of middle and suffix zero blocks; no general all-five-run conclusion is claimed.
